office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Elizabeth Fraser, a District Court judge since 2013, is the only candidate. Elected by South District voters only.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since 2013 and longtime Snohomish County public-defense attorney and administrator, running unopposed.
highlights: District Court judge since 2013; twice presiding judge [S1]
Public defender 1988-2001 and Office of Public Defense attorney administrator 2001-2012 [S1]
Says she embraces her court's therapeutic approach [S1]
